title: Add hands-free content ingestion, auto-rewrite, auto-categorize, image generation, and daily auto-publishing (upgrade without changing URL/design/Google verification)

requirements.text: Preserve the current site URL, routing, design, and layout, and keep Google Search Console verification intact by not removing or altering existing verification/meta tags (including the existing <meta name="google-site-verification" ...> in frontend/index.html).

quotes: Do NOT change URL, design, layout, or Google verification.
Do NOT remove or change any meta tags

acceptanceCriteria: The file frontend/index.html still contains the existing google-site-verification meta tag with the same content value.
No routes in frontend/src/App.tsx are removed or renamed.
Header/footer/layout components remain present and visually consistent (no intentional redesign).

requirements.text: Add backend support for storing and serving dynamically published posts (education news/exam notifications/results/admit cards/scholarships) as persistent data, including fields needed by the existing frontend cards and detail pages (id, title, category, date, excerpt, body, optional stateTags, and an image reference).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes query methods to list posts (optionally filterable by category/state tag/search) and to fetch a single post by id.
Posts persist across canister upgrades (stable storage).
Returned post shape supports the existing frontend post listing and PostDetail views (title, excerpt, date, category, body).

requirements.text: Implement a minimal manual-ingestion mechanism (2–3 times/week) for the site owner to provide raw content or official-source links, which the backend queues for processing and future publishing without requiring ongoing dashboard work.

quotes: I will provide raw content or links from official sources 2–3 times per week

acceptanceCriteria: Backend provides an authenticated/guarded ingestion method that accepts: raw text and/or a source URL, optional hints (desired category/state tags), and stores the submission in a queue.
Frontend provides a minimal submission UI that is not disruptive to the public site experience (e.g., an unlinked route or a simple form page), and submitting shows a success/failure banner.
The ingestion flow does not require changing existing public navigation or layout.

requirements.text: For each ingested item, automatically produce a student-friendly rewritten article in English that is clearly restructured (not a direct copy), including: a simplified title, a short excerpt, and an HTML body with headings and bullet points suitable for the existing PostDetailPage rendering.

quotes: Rewrite in simple, original language for students

acceptanceCriteria: Backend processing generates (or regenerates) title, excerpt, and body HTML from the ingested raw content/link metadata.
Generated body is valid HTML fragments compatible with the current frontend rendering approach.
The output is consistently simpler than the input: includes short sentences, clear steps/dates/eligibility sections when detectable, and avoids copying large contiguous spans from the input.

requirements.text: Automatically assign each processed post to one of the existing site categories (education-news, competitive-exams, results, admit-cards, scholarships, schemes/school-education as applicable) using deterministic rules and/or optional owner-provided hints, and keep tags/stateTags when provided.

quotes: Categorize content correctly into existing sections

acceptanceCriteria: If the owner provides a category hint, it is validated against existing categories and applied.
If no hint is provided, backend assigns a category using keyword/rule-based classification with a sensible fallback to education-news.
Assigned categories match the existing UpdateCategory values used on the frontend.

requirements.text: Automatically generate and attach a relevant image for each published post without relying on third-party AI services, by generating a simple, consistent, category-themed image (e.g., SVG/PNG) derived from the post category and keywords, and make it retrievable by the frontend for display.

quotes: Automatically fetch and upload relevant images for each article

acceptanceCriteria: When a post is published, it has an associated image reference (id/URL/path) that the frontend can render.
Images are produced programmatically within the app stack (no external LLM/image-generation API integration required).
If image generation fails, the post still publishes and the frontend shows a safe fallback image state.

requirements.text: Add a daily backend scheduler that auto-publishes content from the processed queue every day (hands-free) while preserving site uptime and ensuring the public pages continue to show content (never empty) via fallback behavior.

quotes: Website updates itself daily with text and images
Ensure all sections always show updated content (never empty).

acceptanceCriteria: Backend runs a scheduled job daily that publishes at least one queued processed item when available.
If no queued items exist, the site still displays content on each category page (frontend falls back to existing seed content rather than showing empty states).
Publishing does not require manual triggers, logins, or dashboard actions beyond occasional ingestion submissions.

requirements.text: Update the frontend content sources so category pages, search, home 'latest' sections, and post detail pages use backend-published posts first and fall back to existing seedUpdates when backend has no content, without changing existing routes or overall layout.

quotes: Ensure all sections always show updated content
Do NOT change URL, design, layout

acceptanceCriteria: HomePage and category pages show backend posts when available.
When backend returns zero posts for a category, the page renders seedUpdates content instead of 'No updates available' empty states.
Post detail route (/post/$postId) can resolve both backend post ids and seedUpdates ids without breaking navigation.

requirements.text: Add a safe upgrade path for new persistent content data structures in the single Motoko actor, using migration logic only if required to avoid resetting or losing any existing canister state (e.g., current contact submissions/user profiles).

quotes: IMPORTANT: This is an upgrade request, NOT a rebuild. Do NOT change or reset anything already done.

acceptanceCriteria: Existing backend state (contact submissions and user profiles) remains intact after upgrade.
New post/queue state persists across upgrades.
Migration is implemented only if necessary under the project’s conditional migration policy.

constraints: Do not remove or alter any Google Search Console verification/ownership/meta tags or require new verification (frontend/index.html must retain the existing verification meta tag).
Do not change the website URL structure or existing routes.
Do not redesign or change the existing layout; changes must be additive and minimal.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo; migration only when needed).

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Do not implement automated scraping/crawling of arbitrary government/education sites beyond what the owner manually provides as raw content or links.
Do not add third-party authentication providers (only existing Internet Identity patterns if needed).
Do not integrate external LLM or external AI image-generation services/APIs.
Do not add a complex admin dashboard; keep owner input minimal and focused on occasional submissions.
